source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data buffering (PDF 105).

blocks.text: Queues data ke bahao ko buffer karti hain. Online video dekhte waqt woh chhote tukron mein aati hai: buffering queue jo aap dekh rahe hain us se aage ke hisse rakh kar load karti hai, ta ke internet data mein der ho tab bhi video hamwar chale. Printer queue bhi isi tarah kai documents rakh kar mile hue tarteeb mein ek ek kar ke process karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar buffer queue khali ho jaye to streaming video ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Video ruk jati hai ('buffering') jab tak mazeed tukre aa kar enqueue na hon.

items: Buffering: queue istemal se pehle data ke tukre rakhti hai ta ke streaming hamwar rahe.
